description:
HushTelegram v0.0.9 targets telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6 (org.telegram.messenger.web) and the official beta 12.10.7 (org.telegram.messenger.beta) with 25 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. New this time: push registration works on slower phones, HushTelegram settings open from a row in Telegram's own Settings, and new switches add plain-text paste, copyable user and chat IDs and a way to stop double-tap reactions.

If Telegram won't send you a login code, register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 579 runtime tests passed locally. All 303 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 25 patches applied to Telegram 12.10.6 and the 12.10.7 beta without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed. On a slowed-down Android 9 emulator the patched app saved a push token every time.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6, version code 71129, or the beta 12.10.7, version code 71179. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Uninstall the stock Telegram first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
